Same at all three. Clears the pause. A recurring slot missed while paused stays due and fires on the next tick under cron.catch_up_missed (cron/jobs.py resume_job).
Absent at bf0203a (no route, no cancel_job_run in cron/). Stops a run in flight; {cancelled, job_id}; schedule untouched. Pause alone never stops a running job.
Same at all three. Default True: resuming a job paused across its slot runs the missed slot once.

Same at all three. Per-status and per-assignee task counts, oldest ready age. No tokens or cost.

Same at all three. The profile's approval default for chats: manual, smart or off. Readable in GET /api/config.

Same at all three. Ordered list of {provider, model, base_url?, api_key?, key_env?}; legacy fallback_model entries merge after (hermes_cli/fallback_config.py:126). No route edits it alone.

Same at all three. [{name, label, platform, enabled, configured, tools}]: enabled for each toolset's configuration platform (cli for most), not for messaging platforms or cron jobs.

Same at all three. Turn cap per run, default unlimited. Enforced by Hermes; cron honors it too (cron/scheduler.py:2451).
Same at all three. Wall-clock budget per run, default off; wrap-up notice at 80% (agent/turn_iteration_prep.py:183).

Same at all three. Iteration cap for each subagent, separate from the parent's.
Same at all three. Default 1 (children can't spawn children). Also shown by delegation.status.
Same at all three. Parallel children per batch and concurrent background units.
Same at all three. Subagents never ask: false auto-denies dangerous commands, true auto-approves once. The only approval rule a child inherits.
Same at all three. delegate_task narrows a child's toolsets to the parent's; true keeps the parent's MCP toolsets.
Same at all three. Globs that block a terminal command even under YOLO or mode off: a hard command denylist.
Same at all three. Host-wide cap on running kanban tasks (derived from memory when unset); max_in_progress_per_profile caps one profile.
Same at all three. A task auto-blocks after 2 failed attempts in a row.

Same at all three. Cuts empty-reply retries from 3 to 1 when one attempt's input costs this much. The only money threshold Hermes acts on.
Same at all three. Shell hooks; a pre_tool_call hook can block a tool call (agent/shell_hooks.py:4). A building block for an allowlist, not a budget.
